hierarchy.rule: Every child stores parent_task_id and source_iteration_id when applicable.

parallelism.only_when: subtasks have no unresolved dependency edge and do not share mutable workspace state

context_locality.purpose: Select the smallest useful contextual unit before expanding outward, preserving meaning while limiting context load.
context_locality.selection_rule: Start at the smallest locality that can answer or execute the current subtask; expand only when acceptance criteria, references, dependencies, or ambiguity require additional context.

reference_strategy.cross_locality: child context may reference a narrower span inside a broader parent artifact

expansion_triggers: verification needs neighboring or whole-file structure
context_locality.contraction_rule: After expansion, return to the smallest sufficient locality for the next action.
integrity_rules: do not silently merge unrelated spans
preserve source offsets or stable anchors when possible
record expanded locality in the iteration checkpoint
locality never overrides explicit security or human-approval gates

decomposition.target_children: N is dynamically determined by global complexity and required contextual locality; 5 is only a default heuristic.
decomposition.hard_rule: Every leaf iteration must remain independently realizable within exactly one execution iteration/sprint.

causal_temporal_logic.rule: Decompose the global task into causally ordered localities so each child produces the necessary state/output for the next dependent child.
causal_temporal_logic.allow_parallelism: Only for branches with no causal dependency and no shared mutable state.

locality_aware_sizing.rule: Increase or decrease N according to the complexity of the global task and the locality required to make each leaf executable.

decomposition_algorithm: validate every leaf is realizable in one iteration
compose verified outputs into parent result
replan only the unfinished frontier when conditions change
invariants: No child exists solely to satisfy an arbitrary numeric target.
N may be 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, or another justified value.
Increasing N must reduce leaf complexity rather than merely split text.
The parent is complete only when all required causal leaves are accepted and their outputs compose into the parent acceptance criteria.
Completed iterations remain immutable and addressable.
